Genotype-by-environment variances

Source: R/ge_var.R
bys_ls_var.Rd

bys_ls_var() computes the variance of the replicates of every genotype-by-environment cell.

Usage

bys_ls_var(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

# Default S3 method
bys_ls_var(.data, .y, .gen, .env)

Arguments

.data

a data frame with one row per plot.

.y, .gen, .env

the columns of the response, genotypes and environments: bare names, strings or vectors.

Value

A list (class c("bys_ge_var", "bys_result", "list")) with ge_variances, the \(G \times E\) matrix of variances.

Details

$$s^2_{ij} = \frac{1}{n_{ij} - 1}\sum_l (y_{ijl} - \bar{y}_{ij})^2,$$ NA for a cell with one replicate. The within-cell sum of squares of the Bayesian AMMI model is \(\sum_{ij}(n_{ij} - 1)s^2_{ij}\).

Change from the earlier versions. bayes_ammi() used the sum of these variances in place of the within-cell sum of squares.

References

Crossa, J., Perez-Elizalde, S., Jarquin, D., Cotes, J. M., Viele, K., Liu, G. and Cornelius, P. L. (2011). Bayesian estimation of the additive main effects and multiplicative interaction model. \emphCrop Science, \strong51(4), 1458–1469. \doi10.2135/cropsci2010.06.0343

See also

bys_ls_means

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

data(cultivo2009)
bys_ls_var(
    .data = cultivo2009
  , .y    = y
  , .gen  = entry
  , .env  = site
  )
